messages:
matt_g: Quick update — rolling out a new "mini-pool" rotation policy for Dedicated capacity starting next week. This affects small dedicated pools (<= 4 GPUs) in regions where demand spikes frequently.

matt_g: Goal is to improve fairness and reduce long tail wait times while keeping burst behavior predictable. No change to existing Reserved contracts. :sparkles:

sarah_p: TL;DR — if you reserve a mini-pool it may be rotated out of zone for short windows (up to 30m) during high contention. We'll surface replacement pools automatically.

lina_ops: Ops note: we’ll prefer same-region replacements first; cross-region fallback only when absolutely necessary. Customers with strict locality should pin region+zone in their Dedicated config.

devin_sre: For engineers — rollout timeline and checks:
```
# check mini-pool rotation policy for a pool
rwctl dedicated pools describe --pool-id mini-<id> --show-rotation

# preview likely replacement candidates
rwctl dedicated pools candidates --pool-id mini-<id> --region eu-west1
```

devin_sre: We'll also add an event to the pool's audit stream when a rotation is scheduled: `rotation.scheduled` + expected window. Console and API will expose this.

capacity-bot: automated: New policy "mini-pool-rotation-v1" created by matt_g at 2026-04-18T09:00Z. See docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/mini-pools-rotation

sarah_p: Billing impact — no changes to committed hours/pricing. If a rotation causes temporary use of a higher-class GPU (rare), we’ll apply automatic credits for excess unit-hours beyond typical. Details on credits in doc.

matt_g: If you run latency-sensitive workloads that can’t tolerate cross-zone moves, please open a ticket with "mini-pool-exemption" and include perf SLOs; we’ll evaluate exemptions for Enterprise/Private installs.

lina_ops: Runbook excerpt for oncall: when a customer pings about unexpected pool rotation:
- check `rotation.scheduled` events in audit log
- confirm replacement pool and ETA in routing console
- escalate to devin_sre if ETA > 45m or replacement entails different GPU family
devoffice: (internal reminder) we expect ~8% of mini-pools in eu-west1/us-central to see at least one rotation during first 48h of rollout. We’ll monitor and revert thresholds if customer impact rises.

cto_jane: High-level — this change gives us more agility to move small capacity around without impacting large reserved customers. Appreciate teams coordinating on console UX and the customer comm plan.

sarah_p: Customer comm: a short note will go out to active Dedicated customers 24h before region rollouts. We'll include: what happens, how to opt-out, and how credits work.

matt_g: Follow-up actions:
- eng-platform: finish audit events + API fields (devin)
- ops: update runbooks and notify oncall (lina)
- comms: prepare 24h customer notice (sarah)
- legal: quick review of reserved contract language (whoever owns contract changes)

matt_g: ping me here if you want to be on the early-preview list for exempted pools.

sarah_p: Thanks — will circulate the draft notice in #announcements-drafts in 2h. :email:
thread_short_summary: Announcement: rollout of mini-pool rotation policy for small Dedicated GPU pools. Timeline, runbook notes, CLI checks, billing credits, exemption process, and follow-up owners provided.
